name: cook_membrane
source: Cook's membrane (Simo & Rifai / COMSOL convention): panel (0,0)(48,16)(48,32)(0,44) x t, clamped left edge, upward shear on the right edge. Published normalized tip deflection u_y*E*t/P = 23.91 (plane stress); ref = 23.91*P/(E*t) = 0.5978 mm, measured as the loaded-edge mean.
notes: Slanted top/bottom edges voxelize as staircases — systematic under-read of the tip deflection, tightening with pitch. Extruded 3D slab with free z-faces approximates plane stress. Shear + clamp ride on manual_* selections: 'face -x'/'surface -x' envelope semantics pin the top-right corner cell (sole cell of the y>44 columns) — the benchmark needs the strict x=0 clamp and the x=48 shear edge only.
